notes.title: Floor 9 Fix
notes.content:
Fixed a critical coding mistake that make it impossible to complete floor 9. 

Floor 9 can now be completed.

notes.title: Minor Update on UI and update on Floor 8.
notes.content:
Minor Update

Added a restart button to the pause menu. 
Restart button is only accessible to server host in multiplayer

Added "Skip Emails" button to the single player level select screen. 
This will allow you to bypass that level's "email" story screen. 

The next floor is coming along slowly but surely. There is a lot of new code associated with Floor 8 that I've needed to work out a few bugs with. The first portion of the floor was completed today and I will be moving on to the next portion this weekend.

notes.title: Fixes Update
notes.content:
Bugs Fixed: 
Camera clipping through mesh on Floor 10
Screen tearing when stepping through doorways on Floor 10

Graphical fixes: 
Optimized floor 10 for better performance. 
Switched all textures from 8K textures down to 2K textures for better performance.

notes.content: Fixed a typo for the Floor 10 Loading Email.
